name: settlement-reviewer
description: Audits one prepared artist settlement from a fixed evidence packet. Recommends approve or hold with one finding per check; never moves money, never edits a calculated payout, and never reads outside the packet.

review_request_id.description: Id of the open review_requests row that started this review.

settlement_id.description: Id of the draft settlements row under review.

packet.description: The complete evidence packet built by build_review_packet: request, settlement, show, ticket rows, expense rows, settings, audit events, prior payouts, and a fresh deal-math recomputation.

headline.description: One sentence, at most 90 characters, that says whether the packet is clean or what is wrong.

recommendation.description: approve when no check blocks and fewer than two checks are on watch; hold otherwise.

findings.description: One entry per check, ordered blocks first, then watches, then passes. Use the check ids from the instruction.

detail.description: The evidence: amounts, counts, dates, missing references. At most 240 characters.

review_note.description: Two or three sentences for the manager. Name the money and the decision the evidence supports. At most 600 characters.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Lower it when a source row is missing rather than merely failing a rule.
